paragraphs.text: Leylines , sometimes called mana lines , are networks of mana paths that flow across the landscape. They are natural enchantments , found rather than cast, which subtly alter the surrounding environment.
Nissa Revane possesses an instinctive capacity to understand and manipulate leylines. Leylines comprised the gods of Amonkhet , and Nissa was able to manipulate Kefnet as a result.
Kendrin died while researching a connection between Zendikar 's leylines, the Eldrazi , the hedrons , and the Eye of Ugin .

The Eldrazi themselves follow leylines. Nahiri took advantage of that fact to summon Emrakul to Innistrad , by crafting cryptoliths to bend the leylines there. After the War of the Spark , she returned to Zendikar and intended to use to the Lithoform Core to reverse the damage of the earlier Eldrazi attacks on that plane, using a magical focal point in the Singing City to channel the Core's energy through the leylines.
On Ravnica , the leylines formed the Implicit Maze .
In Duskmourn , leylines are portals to the spirit world.
On Muraganda , the leylines form geysers. A culture of ley mages studies them and builds attunement towers in their vicinity.

As of 2026, there are four cycles of leylines, with each card costing 2 M M . To reflect the pre-existing nature of leylines, these cards have the "leyline ability" , If this card is in your opening hand , you may begin the game with it on the battlefield. They were printed in Guildpact , Magic 2011 , Core Set 2020 , and Duskmourn: House of Horror . There are only 15 unique cards across these cycles, due to the reprinting of Leyline of the Void in all four sets, as well as the reprinting of Leyline of Sanctity and Leyline of Anticipation in Core Set 2020 . Some of these cards have also been reprinted, with or without the rest of their cycle, in Commander sets or other products.
Leyline of the Guildpact was printed apart from other leylines in Murders at Karlov Manor , and is the only multicolored leyline.
Leylines are often protective effects. The Guildpact cycle was designed to provide answers to early-game threats, serve as sideboard cards, and mitigate extreme metagame issues.

The earlier card Ley Line is also a 4-mana enchantment, but does not share further mechanical similarities with later leyline cards. In particular, it does not have the opening hand leyline ability. The later Leyline Axe , while not itself a leyline, does have the leyline ability.
In 2026, Quicksilver, Brash Blur ( Marvel Super Heroes ) was the first creature with the leyline ability.
